style_distribution.visible_traits: Indigo copperplate engraving exposes one longitudinal protective shell, a dark reasoning core, screened output channels and a separate campaign lens. Dense crosshatching and ribbon entry differ from every other current treatment.

Moss/terracotta cut-paper relief opens radially around a bound Paper/Code/Data commons, with a withdrawn claim pocket and matched rerun shapes. Visible paper edges and unequal folding silhouettes differ from the engineered shells.

Ochre/graphite matte clay sculpture exposes completed-task cost strata with a thick pending-review result section, one input port and a detached vendor sample. Smooth material volume and heavy frontal mass differ from ink and paper.

Forest/pale-blue ink-gouache side section uses an exposed removable model joint inside one invariant rail, two differently keyed inserts and paired paper tests. Open captions and narrow architectural outlines make the reading path planar.

Raspberry/charcoal linocut forms a sloping accordion with specific request/draft/awaiting-approval/status-row states and a closed exception envelope. Coarse edge grain and unpassed review boundary differ from the model and journal illustrations.

Teal/aubergine translucent pastel anatomy exposes a cylindrical session and a three-layer durable journal, with one curved resumption cable and a separate isolated session. Rounded translucency and vertical history hierarchy differ from other materials.
